verdict.rationale: Phoenix lets you organize traces into projects by environment and run experiments against curated datasets, including staging data. That gives some separation between testing and production, but the docs describe no dedicated sandbox mode or isolation guarantee. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test-environment feature, explicit guarantees that tests cannot touch production data, any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Projects: Organize traces by environment, application, or team
Datasets allow you to collect data from production, staging, evaluations, and even manually.
You can group traces into datasets, rerun them through different versions of your application, and compare evaluation results
